title: Hardship Settlement Extensions: Allowance for a Short Signing Window
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Short-Window Allowance

**Rule.** For a due-date extension on an accepted Hardship Settlement of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements, where the Hardship Settlement signing window, the days from its acceptance date to its first payment due date, is under 14 days, the Hardship Settlement short-window allowance of 4 days is added; where that window is at least 14 days but under 21 days, the short-window allowance is 2 days; a signing window of 21 days or more earns no short-window allowance.

Both dates are on the accepted settlement: the acceptance date and the first payment due date counted from that acceptance.

| Signing window (calendar days) | Short-window allowance |
|---|---|
| 1 to 13 | 4 days |
| 14 to 20 | 2 days |
| 21 or more | none |

## Hypothetical boundary cases

| Acceptance date | First payment due date | Signing window | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| day A | day A plus 13 | 13 days | 4 days |
| day A | day A plus 14 | 14 days | 2 days |
| day A | day A plus 20 | 20 days | 2 days |
| day A | day A plus 21 | 21 days | none |
